evidence.K2: All three invariants: imaginary phase ('purely imaginary rationals like -2304 i. So I write A_n = i P_n'); homogeneity ('Scaling omega->lambda omega multiplies A_n by lambda^(2n-4)'); sign-class symmetry ('flipping omega1,omega2 both negative or both positive gives the same B ... symmetric in the two negative legs').
evidence.K3: Wrote the n-generalized principal-chamber monomial A_n =? i (2^(n-1)/g^(n-3)) omega1 omega2^(2n-5), i.e. omega1 omega2 (omega2^2)^(n-3); log confirms it is the principal-chamber monomial and reproduces the data in that chamber.

evidence.K8: Verified relative error 'identically zero in exact rational arithmetic for n=4,5,6,7 ... including non-generic regimes where one frequency is a hundred times larger or smaller' (hierarchical) and handled the n=4 removable 0/0 via the epsilon->0+ limit (-192 i). one_line_summary: Fugu ultra reached the full box-spline/inclusion-exclusion structure with arbitrary subset-sum walls (K6) and verified exact-zero error within the positive MakeKinematics chart including the n=4 limit, but stalled at a chart-tied formula (S subset {3..n-1}, threshold omega2^2) and never folded the sign-general channels or tested mixed-sign chambers -- a 'near' miss.
